articles.title: Ibyerekeye amategeko n'abantu agenga
articles.content:
1. Amategeko y'umuhanda yerekeye ibinyabiziga, inyamaswa n'abanyamaguru bagendera mu nzira nyabagendwa, yerekeye kandi n'ibinyabiziga n'inyamaswa biri mu nzira zindi zitarimo amakaye igihe cyose biteye impungenge cyangwa byateza impanuka abagenda mu nzira nyabagendwa.
2. Nyamara amategeko y'iri teka ntabwo akurikizwa ku nkomane z'inzira nyabagendwa n'inzira z'ubutaka cyangwa utuyira tw'abanyamaguru n'inzira z'amagare bikoreshwa n'abanyamaguru, uretse igihe biteganyijwe ukundi muri iri teka.
3. Abanyamaguru basunika ibinyamitende cyangwa ibinyabiziga by'abana cyangwa by'abamugaye bagendera ku mategeko agenga abanyamaguru igihe batabangamiye abandi banyamaguru.

articles.title: Amagambo asobanuye
articles.content:
Muri iri teka, amagambo akurikira asobanura:
1. Inzira nyabagendwa: Umuhanda wose, inzira yose, ahantu hose hagendwamo n'abantu benshi, kabone n'iyo haba ku butaka bwite bw'umuntu, igihe cyose hakoreshwa n'abantu benshi.
2. Inzira y'ibinyabiziga: Ubuso bw'inzira nyabagendwa bugendwamo n'ibinyabiziga muri rusange, ariko hakaba hatabariwemo inzira z'impande.
3. Umuhanda: Igice cy'inzira nyabagendwa kigenewe kugendwamo n'ibinyabiziga muri rusange.
4. Igisate cy'umuhanda: Igice cyose cy'umuhanda kigaragazwa cyangwa kitagaragazwa n'imirongo iromboreje, ariko gifite ubugari buhagije kugira ngo ibinyabiziga bibone uko bigenda mu murongo umwe.
5. Inzira y'amagare: Igice cy'inzira nyabagendwa cyagenewe amagare na velomoteri zifite imitende ibiri.
6. Akayira k'abanyamaguru: Igice cy'inzira nyabagendwa cyagenewe abanyamaguru gusa.
7. Amasangano y'imihanda: Aho imihanda ibiri cyangwa myinshi ihurira, yambukiranya cyangwa itandukana.
8. Ikorosi: Ahantu umuhanda uzunguruka, uhindura icyerekezo ku buryo budasanzwe.
9. Imodoka: Ikinyabiziga cyose kigendeshwa na moteri gifite imitende itari munsi y'ine, uretse velomoteri n'amapikipiki.
10. Romoruki: Ikinyabiziga cyose cyagenewe gukururwa n'ikindi.
11. Makuzungu (Semi-remorque): Romoruki yagenewe gufatishwa ku kinyabiziga cyiyikurura ku buryo igice cyayo kiba kikiryamyeho kandi igice cy'uburemere bwacyo n'ubw'ibyo gitwaye bushikamiye icyo kinyabiziga.
12. Ikamyo: Imodoka yagenewe gutwara imizigo irengeje uburemere bwa toni 3.5.
13. Ikamyoneti: Imodoka yagenewe gutwara imizigo itarengeje uburemere bwa toni 3.5.
14. Velomoteri: Ikinyamitende cyose gifite moteri idasumba santimetero kibe 50 kandi umuvuduko utarenza km 50 mu isaha.
15. Ipikipiki: Ikinyamitende cyose gifite moteri isumba santimetero kibe 50.
16. Bisi (Autobus): Ikinyabiziga cyagenewe gutwara abantu barenze umunani baticaye ku ntebe y'umuyobozi.
17. Imodoka ntoya (Voiture): Ikinyabiziga cyagenewe gutwara abantu batarenze umunani baticaye ku ntebe y'umuyobozi.
18. Ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa: Ibinyabiziga bya polisi, ibizimya inkongi, ibitwara abarwayi n'ibindi byemerewe n'amategeko gutambuka mbere y'ibindi igihe bikoresha inzogera zidasanzwe n'amatara y'ubururu amyatsa.

Impanuka (Accidents)

articles.title: Impushya zo gutwara ibinyabiziga (Permis de conduire)
Uruhushya mpuzamahanga rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga (Permis international)
articles.content:
1. Uruhushya mpuzamahanga rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga rutangwa na Polisi y'Igihugu ku muntu ufite uruhushya rusesuye rwo mu Rwanda.
2. Uruhushya mpuzamahanga rumara igihe cy'umwaka umwe (1) uhereye umunsi rwatangiweho.
3. Amahoro yo gutanga uruhushya mpuzamahanga angana n'amafaranga y'u Rwanda ibihumbi makumyabiri (20,000 Frw).
4. Abanyamahanga bafite uruhushya mpuzamahanga rwatanzwe hakurikijwe amasezerano mpuzamahanga y'i Genève (1949) cyangwa Vienne (1968) bemerewe kurukoresha mu Rwanda mu gihe kitarenze umwaka umwe.

articles.chapter_title: Amategeko abagendera mu nzira nyabagendwa bagomba gukurikiza
articles.title: Ukurinda umuhanda (Protection of the road)
articles.content:
1. Birabujijwe kwangiza umuhanda, kubangamira abawugendamo cyangwa gushyira mu kaga abandi bakoresha umuhanda.
2. Birabujijwe gusiga ku muhanda ikintu cyose gishobora gutera impanuka, nko kumena amavuta, lisansi, amabuye, ibyuma cyangwa imyanda.
3. Iyo umuyobozi agize icyo ata ku muhanda cyangwa ikinyabiziga cye cyangije umuhanda, agomba guhita agikuraho cyangwa kubimenyesha ubutegetsi bw'ibanze n'abashinzwe umuhanda.

key_values.rule: Strict prohibition of road damage or littering

articles.chapter_title: Amategeko abagendera mu nzira nyabagendwa bagomba gukurikiza
articles.title: Abashinzwe kuyobora (Driver vigilance)
articles.content:
1. Buri kinyabiziga kigenda cyangwa inyamaswa igenda mu nzira nyabagendwa igomba kugira umuyobozi.
2. Umuyobozi wese agomba guhora yiteguye gutegeka ikinyabiziga cye cyangwa inyamaswa ayoboye, akagendera ku muvuduko umwemerera guhagarara imbere y'inkomyi iyo ari yo yose ishobora kuboneka mu cyerekezo cye.

key_values.rule: Continuous vigilance and full vehicle control

articles.chapter_title: Amategeko abagendera mu nzira nyabagendwa bagomba gukurikiza
articles.title: Ibikoresho n'ibinyabiziga binyura mu muhanda
articles.content:
1. Ibinyabiziga n'ibikoresho bigendeshwa mu muhanda bigomba kuba bifite inziga zidashobora kwangiza umuhanda.
2. Birabujijwe kunyuza mu muhanda wa kaburimbo ibinyabiziga bifite imitende y'ibyuma ifite amano cyangwa iminyururu (chenilles) bitabiherewe uruhushya rwihariye n'umutegetsi ubifitiye ububasha.

key_values.prohibition: No steel-tracked or spudded vehicles on asphalt without permit

articles.chapter_title: Amategeko abagendera mu nzira nyabagendwa bagomba gukurikiza
articles.title: Imyaka ntarengwa (Minimum age limits)
articles.content:
Imyaka y'amavuko ntarengwa yo gutwara ibinyabiziga n'inyamaswa mu nzira nyabagendwa iteye itya:
1. Imyaka makumyabiri (20):
- Ku modoka zagenewe gutwara imizigo irengeje toni 3.5 (Urwego C);
- Ku modoka zagenewe gutwara abantu barenze umunani (Urwego D);
- Ku binyabiziga bikurura romoruki zikomeye (Urwego E);
- Ku binyabiziga by'abamugaye byahinduwe (Urwego F).
2. Imyaka cumi n'umunani (18):
- Ku binyabiziga by'urwego A (amapikipiki);
- Ku binyabiziga by'urwego B (imodoka nto zagenewe abantu batarenze 8 cyangwa imizigo itarengeje toni 3.5).
3. Imyaka cumi n'irindwi (17) cyangwa cumi n'itanu (15):
- Kuri velomoteri n'amagare agendamo abantu.
4. Imyaka cumi n'ine (14):
- Ku bayobozi b'inyamaswa zikurura ibinyabiziga cyangwa izikorera imizigo.
5. Imyaka cumi n'ibiri (12):
- Ku bayobozi b'imikumbi y'amatungo.

articles.chapter_title: Aho ibinyabiziga bigomba kunyura mu muhanda
articles.title: Kugendera iburyo (Driving on the right)
articles.content:
1. Umuyobozi wese w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugendera mu ruhande rw'iburyo bw'umuhanda, akegera inkombe y'iburyo uko bishoboka kose, cyane cyane mu makorosi, hejuru y'imisozi, n'igihe agiye kubisikana cyangwa kunyuranaho.
2. Iyo umuhanda ugabanyijwemo ibisate byinshi, umuyobozi agomba gukoresha igisate cy'iburyo buse uretse igihe ashaka kunyura ku bindi binyabiziga cyangwa gukatira ibumoso.

key_values.rule: Drive on the right-hand side close to edge

articles.chapter_title: Aho ibinyabiziga bigomba kunyura mu muhanda
articles.title: Imihanda ifite ibisate binyuranye (Multi-lane roads)
articles.content:
1. Mu mihanda ifite ibisate bitatu cyangwa birenga bigana mu cyerekezo kimwe:
- Ibinyabiziga bikurura romoruki n'imodoka zifite uburemere burenze toni 3.5 zibujijwe gukoresha igisate cy'ibumoso bwa byose, uretse igihe zigiye gukatira ibumoso.
2. Kugenda ku mirongo ibangikanye (circulation en files parallèles) byemewe gusa igihe hari urujya n'uruza runini rw'ibinyabiziga (embouteillage) kandi ibisate byose byuzuye.

key_values.heavy_vehicles_left_lane: Forbidden on far left lane except when turning left

articles.chapter_title: Aho ibinyabiziga bigomba kunyura mu muhanda
articles.title: Ahantu hari inkomyi (Passing obstacles)
articles.content:
1. Iyo umuyobozi anyuze iruhande rw'inkomyi cyangwa abanyamaguru bagendera mu muhanda, agomba gusiga umwanya utari munsi ya metero imwe (1 m) hagati yabo n'inkomyi cyangwa abanyamaguru.
2. Iyo bidashoboka gusiga iyo ntera ya metero imwe, umuyobozi agomba kugabanya umuvuduko we ukaba utarengeje kilometero eshanu mu isaha (5 km/h).

articles.title: Gutambuka mbere kw'iburyo (Priority to the right)
Kwinjira mu yindi nzira no gusubira inyuma
articles.content:
1. Umuyobozi ugiye kwinjira mu nzira nyabagendwa avuye mu yindi nzira idafite kaburimbo, mu kibanza cyiteganye cyangwa mu gipangu, agomba guhagarara akabanza kureka abagenzi bose bagendera muri iyo nzira nyabagendwa bagatambuka.
2. Umuyobozi usubira inyuma (marche arrière) agomba kureka abandi bagenzi bose bagatambuka kandi agasubira inyuma ku ntera ngufi ishoboka bitabangamiye umutekano.

key_values.rule: Yield to all traffic when entering from private property or unpaved track

articles.title: Uko bagenza mu masangano azengurukwamo (Roundabouts)
articles.content:
1. Mu masangano azengurukwamo (rond-point) aranzwe n'icyapa D.3 cyangwa ibimenyetso bibigenga, ibinyabiziga bimaze kwinjira mu masangano birusha uburenganzira bwo gutambuka ibigiye kwinjiramo.
2. Umuyobozi ugiye kwinjira mu masangano azengurukwamo agomba guha inzira ibinyabiziga biturutse ibumoso bimaze kugera mu masangano.

key_values.roundabout_priority: Traffic inside the circle has right-of-way over entering traffic

articles.title: Amasangano y'umuhanda n'inzira ya gariyamoshi (Level crossings)
articles.content:
1. Ikinyabiziga kigendera ku njanzi (gariyamoshi) gihora gifite uburenganzira busesuye bwo gutambuka mbere y'ibindi binyabiziga byose.
2. Abagendera mu muhanda bose bagomba guhagarara imbere y'inzira ya gariyamoshi igihe icyapa cyangwa amatara amyatsa atukura bitegeka guhagarara cyangwa igihe inzitizi (barrières) zatangiye kumanuka.

articles.title: Guhindura icyerekezo (Changing direction)
Kubisikana (Passing oncoming traffic)
articles.content:
1. Kubisikana bikorerwa mu ruhande rw'iburyo.
2. Mu mihanda ifunganye cyane yo mu misozi:
- Ikinyabiziga kimanuka kigomba guhagarara kigaheza inzira ikizamuka;
- Iyo binyuze mu gusubira inyuma, ikinyabiziga kimwe kigomba gusubira inyuma imbere y'ikinyabiziga giteranije cyangwa ikiremereye; ikinyabiziga kimanuka gisubira inyuma imbere y'ikizamuka.

key_values.mountain_road_priority: Downhill yields to uphill; lighter yields to heavier

articles.title: Kunyuranaho (Overtaking)
Aho bibujijwe kunyuranaho (Prohibited overtaking zones)

key_values.prohibition: No overtaking at crests, curves, railway crossings, continuous line, zebra crossings

articles.title: Kunyuranaho gukozwe n'ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri
articles.content:
1. Iyo ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri kinyuze ku bindi binyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri, kigomba kubikora vuba bishoboka kikongera kwinjira mu ruhande rwacyo rw'iburyo nta guteza ingorane uwo kimaze kunyuraho.
2. Umuyobozi uri kunyurwaho abujijwe kongera umuvuduko we; agomba kuguma ku muvuduko yari ariho cyangwa akawugabanya akegera inkombe y'iburyo.

articles.title: Ibinyabiziga birengeje metero 8 z'uburebure (Long vehicles signaling)
articles.content: Ibinyabiziga cyangwa ibiteranije birengeje metero umunani (8 m) z'uburebure cyangwa uburemere bwa toni 3.5 bidashobora kugenda ku muvuduko urenze kilometero 40 mu isaha, bigomba korohereza ibindi kubinyuraho binyuze mu gukikira inkombe y'iburyo no gutanga ikimenyetso cy'uko bibonye abashaka kubinyuraho.

articles.title: Ibinyabiziga binyuranaho ku buryo budasanzwe
articles.content: Iyo ibinyabiziga bibiri birimo gukurikirana mu murongo umwe mu gihe cy'urujya n'uruza runini (files ininterrompues), umuyobozi ashobora kunyura ku cyo ku rundi ruhande bitewe n'uko umurongo arimo wihuta kurusha undi, ibyo ntibifatwa nka rurangiza yo kunyuranaho bitemewe.

key_values.rule: Lane queuing speed variation is not considered illegal overtaking

articles.title: Umuvuduko rusange (General speed requirements)
Umuvuduko ntarengwa ahatari mu nsisiro (Speed limits outside built-up areas)
Umuvuduko ntarengwa mu nsisiro (Speed limits in built-up areas)
articles.content:
Mu nsisiro (agglomerations), umuvuduko ntarengwa w'ibinyabiziga uteye gutya:
1. Kilometero mirongo itanu mu isaha (50 km/h):
- Ku modoka ntoya zagenewe gutwara abantu zitarengeje uburemere bwa toni imwe (1 T);
2. Kilometero mirongo ine mu isaha (40 km/h):
- Ku bindi binyabiziga byose (ikamyo, amabisi, velomoteri n'imodoka zose zirengeje toni imwe).

articles.title: Umuvuduko munini udasanzwe (Exemptions to speed limits)
Intera igomba kuranga ibinyabiziga bikurikiranye (Following distance)
articles.content:
1. Umuyobozi wese w'ikinyabiziga gikurikiye ikindi agomba gusiga intera ihagije hagati yacyo n'ikiri imbere ye kugira ngo ashobore guhagarara nta mpanuka igihe ikiri imbere gihagaze gitunguranye.
2. Iyo ibinyabiziga birengeje uburemere bwa toni 3.5 cyangwa uburebure bwa metero umunani (8 m) bigendera ahatari mu nsisiro, bigomba gusiga intera itari munsi ya metero mirongo itanu (50 m) hagati yabyo kugira ngo borohereze ibinyabiziga bito kubinyuraho.

articles.chapter_title: Guhagarara akanya gato no guhagarara umwanya munini
articles.title: Amategeko rusange yo guhagarara
articles.content:
1. Guhagarara akanya gato cyangwa umwanya munini bigomba gukorerwa ku ruhande rw'iburyo bw'umuhanda mu cyerekezo cy'urugendo.
2. Mu mihanda igenderwamo mu cyerekezo kimwe gusa (sens unique), guhagarara bishobora no gukorerwa ku ruhande rw'ibumoso iyo nta cyapa kibibuza.
3. Ikinyabiziga kigomba guhagarikwa cyegeranye cyane n'inkombe y'umuhanda, mu buryo butabangamiye urujya n'uruza rw'abandi bagenzi.

key_values.rule: Park on right side in direction of travel; on left allowed in one-way streets

articles.chapter_title: Guhagarara akanya gato no guhagarara umwanya munini
articles.title: Aho guhagarara n'intera zitegetswe (Clearances when parking)
articles.content:
1. Hagati y'ikinyabiziga gihagaze n'umurongo wera ukomeje ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri hagomba gusigara umwanya utari munsi ya metero eshatu (3 m).
2. Iyo ikinyabiziga gihagaze ku ruhande rw'umuhanda hateganye n'ikindi kinyabiziga gihagaze ku rundi ruhande:
- Mu muhanda ugendwamo mu byerekezo byombi hagomba gusigara umwanya wa metero esheshatu (6 m) nibura;
- Mu muhanda ugendwamo mu cyerekezo kimwe hagomba gusigara umwanya wa metero eshatu (3 m) nibura.
3. Intera isigara hagati y'ibinyabiziga bibiri bihagaze ku ruhande rumwe rw'umuhanda:
- Metero eshanu (5 m) mu nsisiro;
- Metero makumyabiri (20 m) ahatari mu nsisiro.

articles.chapter_title: Guhagarara akanya gato no guhagarara umwanya munini
articles.title: Aho bibujijwe guhagarara akanya gato n'umwanya munini (Stopping and parking forbidden)

articles.chapter_title: Guhagarara akanya gato no guhagarara umwanya munini
articles.title: Aho bibujijwe guhagarara umwanya munini (Parking forbidden)

key_values.prohibition: No parking in front of driveways, bus stops, yellow broken curb marking, schools

articles.chapter_title: Guhagarara akanya gato no guhagarara umwanya munini
articles.title: Igihe ntarengwa cyo guhagarara umwanya munini (Max parking duration)
articles.content:
1. Birabujijwe gusiga ikinyabiziga gihagaze ahantu hamwe mu nzira nyabagendwa mu gihe kirenze iminsi irindwi (7) ikurikirana.
2. Iyo icyo gihe kirenze, ikinyabiziga gifatwa nk'icyatawe kikajyanwa mu bubiko bwa Polisi (mise en fourrière) ku kiguzi cya nyiracyo.

articles.title: Ibiranga ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa (Priority vehicles)
Uko bagendera mu muhanda imbere y'ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa
articles.content:
1. Umuyobozi wese w'ikinyabiziga cyangwa inyamaswa ubonye ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa kije gitanga ibimenyetso byacyo agomba:
a) Guhita yegera inkombe y'iburyo bw'umuhanda;
b) Guhagarara akanya gato niba bibaye ngombwa kugira ngo agihe umwanya uhagije wo gutambuka.
2. Ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa bishobora kurenga ku mategeko y'umuvuduko ntarengwa no ku bimenyetso by'amatara y'umuhanda, ariko ababiyobora bagomba kwitonda kugira ngo batateza impanuka abandi bagenzi.

key_values.duty: Pull to the right and stop immediately for priority vehicles

articles.title: Ibinyabiziga biherekeranye (Convoys)
articles.content:
1. Ibinyabiziga bigendera mu matsinda aherekeranye (convois) bigomba kugabanywamo amatsinda atarengeje uburebure bwa metero 500.
2. Hagati y'itsinda n'irindi hagomba gusigara umwanya utari munsi ya metero mirongo itanu (50 m).
3. Hagati y'imodoka n'indi mu itsinda hagomba gusigara umwanya wa metero mirongo itatu (30 m).
4. Imodoka y'imbere igomba gushyirwaho icyapa cy'umuhondo cyanditsweho 'ATTENTION CONVOI' mu nyuguti zitukura, naho iy'inyuma ikagira icyapa cyanditsweho 'FIN DE CONVOI'.

articles.title: Amateme (Bridges and weight limits)
articles.content:
1. Uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe bunyuzwa ku mateme akozwe mu ngiga z'ibiti cyangwa imbaho ni toni umunani (8 T).
2. Uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe bunyuzwa ku mateme akozwe mu byuma bitindishije ni toni mirongo ine n'esheshatu (46 T).
3. Iyo imodoka zifite uburemere burenze toni 5 zikurikiranye kugira ngo zinyure ku iteme, hagati yazo hagomba gusigara umwanya utari munsi ya metero cumi (10 m).

articles.title: Ibinyabiziga bikora mu muhanda (Road maintenance vehicles)
articles.content: Ibinyabiziga bikora imirimo yo kubaka, gusana cyangwa gusukura umuhanda bishobora gukoresha igice cy'umuhanda gifunzwe cyangwa gukata aho bibujijwe, igihe gusa biri mu mirimo yabyo kandi bifite itara ry'umuhondo rimyatsa ribonwa mu mpande zose.

key_values.flashing_light: Amber flashing light for maintenance machinery

articles.title: Igihe amatara agomba gukoreshwa (Lighting periods)
articles.content:
1. Amatara y'ibinyabiziga agomba gucanwa:
a) Kuva bwije kugeza bukeye (kuva saa kumi n'ebyiri z'umugoroba kugeza saa kumi n'ebyiri za mu gitondo);
b) Ku manywa igihe cyose ikirere kimeze nabi (imvura, igihu, umukungugu) bituma umuyobozi adashobora kubona neza muri metero 100 imbere ye.
2. Ikinyabiziga gihagaze ku muhanda nijoro cyangwa aho hatabona kigomba kumurikwa n'amatara ndanga (feux de position).

key_values.period: Between dusk and dawn, and whenever visibility is under 100m

articles.title: Amatara y'ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri
Gukoresha amatara maremare n'amagufi (Use of high and low beams)
Amatara ndanga (Position lights)
articles.content:
1. Amatara ndanga agomba kwaka igihe ikinyabiziga gihagaze ku muhanda ahatabona kugira ngo kiboneke n'abandi bagenzi.
2. Nijoro, amatara ndanga y'imbere agomba kugaragara muri metero 150 igihe ijuru rikeye, naho ay'inyuma akagaragara muri metero 150.

articles.title: Amatara y'ibindi binyabiziga (Other vehicle lighting)
articles.content:
1. Amagare agomba kugira itara rimwe ryera cyangwa ry'umuhondo imbere n'itara rimwe ritukura inyuma nijoro, hamwe n'utugarurarumuri tw'umuhondo ku birenge by'amagare (pédales).
2. Ibinyabiziga bikururwa n'inyamaswa bigomba kugira itara ryera imbere ku ruhande rw'ibumoso n'itara ritukura inyuma ku ruhande rw'ibumoso.

key_values.bicycle_lights: White/yellow front, red rear, yellow reflectors on pedals

articles.title: Ibimenyetso by'urugendo n'imburira zimurika (Optical warning signals)
articles.content:
1. Kugira ngo aburire abandi bagenzi mu gihe cy'impanuka cyangwa ibyago, umuyobozi ashobora gukoresha imburira zimurika (appel de phares) binyuze mu gucana no kuzimya vuba vuba amatara maremare n'amagufi.
2. Gucanira rimwe amatara yose ndangacyerekezo (feux de détresse / hazard lights) bikorwa gusa igihe ikinyabiziga kigize ingorane kigahagarara aho bibujijwe cyangwa giteje ibyago.

key_values.hazard_lights_usage: Only when broken down or immobilized causing a hazard

articles.title: Ihoni (Audible warning devices / horns)
Ingingo ya 47 bis: Imikandara yo kwirinda ibyago (Seat belts)
Abanyamaguru (Pedestrians rules)
articles.content:
1. Abanyamaguru bagomba kugendera mu tuyira tw'abanyamaguru cyangwa ku nkengero z'umuhanda (trottoirs et accotements).
2. Iyo nta kayira k'abanyamaguru gahari, bashobora kugendera ku nkombe y'umuhanda, bagana mu cyerekezo kibisikana n'ibinyabiziga (ku ruhande rw'ibumoso bwabo), kugira ngo babone ibinyabiziga bibegera.

key_values.pedestrian_side_without_sidewalk: Walk on the left facing oncoming traffic

articles.title: Ahanyurwa n'abanyamaguru (Pedestrian crossings)
articles.content:
1. Abanyamaguru bagomba kwambukiranya umuhanda banyuze mu myanya yabagenewe (passages pour piétons) igihe iri mu ntera itarenze metero mirongo itanu (50 m) aho bari.
2. Iyo nta mwanya wabagenewe uri hafi, banyura mu buryo bugororotse ku nkengero z'umuhanda bamaze kwiringira ko batateza impanuka.

articles.title: Amakoraniro y'abantu n'ingabo ziri ku murongo (Crowds and troops)
articles.content:
1. Birabujijwe gukata cyangwa gucamo kabiri imirongo y'ingabo, urubyiruko rw'abanyeshuri bari ku murongo bayobowe na mwarimu, cyangwa imirongo y'abaherekeje umuhango wo gushyingura.
2. Amakoraniro y'abantu n'ingabo ziri ku murongo bagendera mu ruhande rw'iburyo bw'umuhanda, bakagira abantu bafite amatara y'umweru imbere n'atukura inyuma nijoro.

key_values.prohibition: Cutting through military, student or funeral processions is strictly forbidden

articles.title: Abayobozi b'amagare na velomoteri (Cyclists and velomotor riders)
Abayobozi b'amatungo n'imikumbi (Livestock herds)
Aho bibujijwe kuragira no kwinjiza amatungo
articles.content: Birabujijwe kuragira, kwinjiza cyangwa kurekura amatungo mu nzira nyabagendwa, mu nkengero zayo, cyangwa mu bice by'umuhanda bifunzwe.

key_values.prohibition: No grazing or unattended livestock on public roads

articles.title: Imyitwarire ku biraro n'ibyambu (Ferries and narrow bridges)
articles.content:
1. Ku biraro bifunganye no ku byambu by'amato yambuka inzuzi (bacs), ibinyabiziga byinjira bikurikiranye umwe ku wundi hakurikijwe amabwiriza y'abashinzwe kubiyobora.
2. Abagenzi bari mu modoka bagomba gusohoka mu kinyabiziga mbere y'uko cyinjira mu bwato bwambuka (bac).

key_values.safety_rule: Passengers must alight before vehicle boards ferry (bac)

articles.title: Ibyambu n'ibibuga by'indege (Ports and airports)
articles.content: Amategeko agenga umutekano mu mihanda yo mu byambu, ku bibuga by'indege no mu bigo bya gisirikari agengwa n'amabwiriza yihariye y'ubutegetsi bubishinzwe.

key_values.rule: Special administrative regulations govern ports and airports

articles.title: Aho bisi zihagarara (Bus stops)
articles.content:
1. Aho bisi zihagarara (arrêts d'autobus) haranzwe n'icyapa E.9 cyangwa E.19 bis, cyangwa imirongo y'umweru mu muhanda.
2. Birabujijwe guhagarara akanya gato cyangwa umwanya munini ku bindi binyabiziga mu ntera ya metero cumi n'eshanu (15 m) mbere na metero cumi n'eshanu (15 m) nyuma y'icyapa kiranga aho bisi zihagarara.

articles.title: Ingingo ya 56 bis: Amategeko yihariye ku mihanda y'imodoka (Motorways / Autoroutes)
Uburumbarare bw'ibinyabiziga n'ibikururana (Vehicle Dimensions)
articles.content:
Uburumbarare bw’ikinyabiziga cyangwa bw’ibinyabiziga bikururana n’ibirenze ku mubyimba wabyo hatabariwemo amatara yerekana icyerekezo n’indorerwamo zibonesha ibiturutse inyuma ntibishobora kurenza izi ngero:
1. Ubugari bupimiwe mu butambike ubwo ari bwo bwose: metero 2 na santimetero 65 (2.65 m). Ariko ubugari bwa romoruki ntiburenza:
a) Santimetero 75 iyo zikuruwe n’igare cyangwa velomoteri;
b) Metero 1 na santimetero 25 iyo ikuruwe n’ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga kometse ku ruhande;
c) Ubugari bw’ikinyabiziga gikurura iyo gikuruwe n’ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga kometse ku ruhande rwayo, cyangwa iyo ikuruwe n’ikinyamitende itatu cyangwa ine, gifite cyangwa kidafite moteri.
Byongeye kandi ibinyabiziga bihinga, iyo biva aho biba bijya mu mirima cyangwa iyo bitahuka kandi bikaba bitarengeje umuvuduko wa kilometero 20 mu isaha bishobora kugera kubugari ntarengwa bwa metero 3 (3 m).
Ariko ibice by’inyuma bihindukizwa cyangwa bishobora gukurwaho nta ngorane, bigomba guhinwa cyangwa gukurwaho kugirango ubugari bugabanuke mu gihe bikigendera mu nzira nyabagendwa.
Uburenganzira buvugwa mu gika kibanziriza iki bukurikizwa ku mashini zikoreshwa n’abapatanye imirimo, iyo zivuye mu igaraji zijya aho imirimo ikorerwa, cyangwa iyo zivuye mu mirimo zimukiye ahandi, ariko ntizirenze umuvuduko wa kilometero 20 mu isaha.

2. Uburebure bw’ikinyabiziga cyangwa bw’ibinyabiziga bikururana:
a) Uburebure ntiburenza metero 7 ku kinyabiziga gifite:
- Umutambiko umwe uhuza imipira;
- Imitabiko ibiri ikurikiranye mu bubugari bwayo, ni ukuvuga imitambiko yihindukiza kucyo ifungiyeho;
- Imitambiko ibiri ifite ikiyihuza, kandi intera hagati yayo ntirenze metero imwe na santimetero 60 (1.60 m) ni ukuvuga imitambiko ikoranye ariko hatabariwemo icyuma cyagenewe ibikurura.
b) Uburebure ntiburenza metero 11 ku binyabiziga bifite imitambiko ibiri cyangwa irenga, hadashyizweho icyuma gituma zifata iyo ari ikinyabiziga gikuruwe n’ikindi cyangwa gikuruwe n’inyamaswa.
c) Uburebure bwa makuzungu ntiburenza metero 17 na santimetero 40 (17.40 m).
d) Mu gihe umuhanda umeze neza, Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu ashobora kwemerera ibigo bya Leta cyangwa ibindi bigenewe gutwara abantu, kuwunyuzamo ibinyabiziga byazo bifite uburebure butarenze metero 13 (13 m).
e) Uburebure bw’ibinyabiziga bikururana, hashyizweho ibituma zikururana icya mbere kikaba gikururwa n’inyamaswa ntiburenza metero 18 (18 m).

3. Ubuhagarike bw’ikinyabiziga: metero 4 na santimetero 20 (4.20 m).

4. Igice kirenga ku biziga (overhang):
- By’inyuma: metero 3 na santimetero 50 (3.50 m);
- By’imbere: metero 2 na santimetero 70 (2.70 m);
Na none kandi, ku binyabiziga bifite imitambiko ibiri hagati ya za agisi hakaba hasumba metero imwe na santimetero 60 igice kirenga ku biziga by’ibyuma ntigishobora kurenza 65/100 by’uburebure buri hagati y’ibiziga by’inyuma n’iby’imbere naho ikirenga ku biziga ikirenga ku biziga by’imbere ntikirenza 55/100 by’ubwo burebure.
Iyo ikinyabiziga gifite imitambiko irenze ibiri, muri yo ikaba ikurikiranye, uburebure buri hagati y’imipira y’inyuma n’iyi’imbere n’uburebure bw’ibice birenga ku mipira, bupimwa bahereye ku mitambiko iteganye.

articles.title: Iminyururu n'ibyuma bimanitse (Chains and hanging parts)
articles.content:
Iminyururu n’ibindi byuma bishobora kuvanwaho cyangwa binagana hatabariwemo ibimenyetso byerekana ibyerekezo bigomba gufungirwa ku binyabiziga ku buryo igihe byizunguza bitarenga impande ziheza uburumbarare bw’ikinyabiziga.
Ibyo byuma bifashisha ntibigomba gukururuka ku butaka, ibyo nyamara ntibibujijwe ku mashini zihinga no kubyerekeye iminyururu.

key_values.hanging_parts_prohibition: Cannot drag on the ground or extend beyond vehicle width

articles.title: Iruhushya rwihariye ku burumbarare burenze urugero (Special authorization for oversized vehicles)
articles.content: Ku buryo budasanzwe kandi bunyuranyije n’ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 57 Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu cyangwa intumwa ze, ashobora igihe hari impamvu ikomeye cyane kwemerera kugenda mu muhanda ibinyabiziga byakorewe imirimo yihariye kandi bifite uburumbarare burenga ubuteganyijwe ntarengwa.

articles.title: Amategeko rusange yo gupakira imizigo (General loading rules)

loading_safety_requirements: no obstruction of lights, mirrors, plates

articles.title: Uburumbarare bw'imizigo (Cargo Dimensions)
articles.content:
Uburumbarare bw’ikinyabiziga gipakiye yaba imodoka, yaba ikinyabiziga gikururwa n’inyamaswa cyangwa romoruki hapimiwemo n’ibirenze ku mubyimba ntibushobora kurenga ingero zikurikira:
1. Ubugari bupimiwe mu butambike ubwo ari bwo bwose: metero 2 santimetero 50 (2.50 m). Nyamara:
a) Iyo imizigo igizwe n’ibinyampeke, ikawa, amakara, ipamba idatonoye, ibishashara ibyatsi ibishami cyangwa ibyats by’amatungo idahambiriye uretse amapaki afunze, ubugari bwayo bushobora kugera kuri metero 2 na santimetero 75 (2.75 m);
b) Iyo imizigo igizwe n’ibimaze kuvugwa haruguru kandi ikaba ijyanwa mu karere katarenze kirometero 25 uvuye aho yapakiriwe, ubugari bwayo bushobora kugera kuri metero 3 usibye mu nsisiro.
Mu biteganyijwe mu migemo a) na b) ibanza nta nkingi n’imwe ikomeye ishobora gushyirwaho ku buryo igice cyayo icyo ari cyo cyose cyarenga metero 1 na santimetero 25 uhereye ku murongo ugabanya ikinyabiziga mo kabiri mu burebure bwacyo.
2. Uburebure: haseguriwe amategeko yerekeye gutwara ibintu birebire cyane, imizigo ntishobora gusumba ikinyabiziga, cyangwa yaba ari ikinyabiziga gikuruwe n’inyamaswa, umutwe w’ikibikurura.
3. Ubuhagarike: Metero 4 keretse iyo hari uruhushya rudasanzwe rutanzwe na Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu cyangwa rutanzwe n’umukuru w’Intara iyo gutwara ibintu ku buryo budasanzwe bikorewe mu ifasi y’Intara imwe gusa.

key_values.cargo_front_prohibition: Cannot extend past front of vehicle or head of draught animal

articles.title: Imizigo miremire idashobora kugabanywamo ibice (Indivisible long loads)
articles.content:
1. Iyo ikinyabiziga gikoreye ibintu birebire bidashobora kugabanywa, icyo gihe imizigo ntishobora kurenza metero 3 ku mpera y’inyuma y’ikinyabiziga (3 m).
2. Imitwaro miremire igomba guhambiranwa ku buryo budanangiye no kuzirika ku kinyabiziga kugirango igihe yicunda itarenga impande z’ikinyabiziga.

articles.title: Ikimenyetso cy'imizigo isumba inyuma (Marking of rear cargo overhang)
articles.content:
Iyo imizigo isumba ipera y’inyuma y’ikinyabiziga ho metero irenga (> 1 m), igice gihera cy’imizigo kigomba kugaragazwa:
- Ku manywa: n’agatambaro gatukura gafite byibura santimetero 50 z’uruhande (50 x 50 cm);
- Iyo amatara y’ibinyabiziga agomba gucanwa: ni itara ritukura cyangwa akagarura-rumuri gatukura.
Ibimenyetso bikoreshwa kugirango impera y’inyuma y’imizigo ntibishobora gushyirwa ku buhagarike burenze metero 1 na santimetero 55 (1.55 m) uhereye ku butaka.

key_values.day_marker: Red cloth at least 50 x 50 cm

articles.title: Imizigo ku binyamitende n'amapikipiki (Cargo on cycles and motorcycles)
articles.content:
1. Ubugari bw’imizigo yikorewe n’amagare na velomoteri kimwe na romoruki zikuruwe n’ibyo binyabiziga ntibushobora kurenga santimetero 75 (75 cm). Uburebure burenga inyuma ni santimetero 50 (50 cm).
2. a) Ubugari bw’imizigo, yikorewe n’amapikipiki adafite akanyabiziga ku ruhande kimwe na romoruki zikururwa n’ibyo binyabiziga ntibushobora kurenga metero 1.25 (1.25 m).
b) Ubugari bw’imizigo yikorewe n’ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande kimwe n’ubw’iya romoruki ikuruwe na bene icyo kinyabiziga ntibushobora kurenza santimetero 30 ku bugari bw’icyo kinyabiziga kidapakiye.
3. Ubugari bw’imizigo yikorewe n’ikinyamitende itatu n’ubw’iyikorewe n’ibinyamitende ine bifite cyangwa bidafite moteri kimwe n’ubw’iyikorewe na romoruki zikuruwe n’ibyo binyabiziga ntibushobora kurenza santimetero 30 ku bugari bw’icyo kinyabiziga kidapakiye, kandi ubugari ntarengwa budakuka bukaba metero 2 na santimetero 50 (2.50 m).

articles.title: Imizigo ku mpera y'imbere n'iy'inyuma ku binyamitende (Front/rear overhang on 2/3/4-wheelers)
articles.content: Imizigo yikorewe n’amagare, velomoteri, amapikipiki, ibinyamitende by’ibiziga bitatu n’ibyine bifite cyangwa bidafite moteri ntibishobora kurenza impera y’imbere y’ikinyabiziga, n’aho iyinyuma ntishobora kurenza santimetero 50 (50 cm).

articles.title: Gutwara abantu n'intebe z'umuyobozi (Carrying persons and seat dimensions)
articles.content:
a).1. Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga cyangwa uw’ikinyamitende itatu cyangawa w’ikinyamitende ine bifite moteri agomba kugira aho yicara hafite ubugari butari munsi ya santimetero 55 (55 cm).
Umuyobozi wa kimwe mu binyabiziga bivugwa mu gika kibanziriza iki ntashobora kwemerera abandi bantu kwicarana nawe mu gihe umwe muri bo adafite umwanya wo kwicaramo ungana nibura na santimetero 40 z’ubugari (40 cm).
2. Birabujijwe: Gutwara ku ntebe z’ikinyabiziga umubare w’abantu urenze umubare wateganyijwe n’uwayikoze.
3. Birabujijwe: Gutwara ku ntebe y’imbere y’imodoka abana badafite imyaka cumi n’ibiri (12) iyo harimo indi myanya.
4. Umuyobozi wa kimwe mu binyabiziga byavuzwe mu gika cya mbere abujijwe gutwara abantu mu bice by’inyuma bya karisoro y’icyo kinyabiziga cyangwa bya romoruki yacyo.
5. Igare, velomoteri, n’ipikipiki ntibishobora gutwara abantu barenze umubare wateganyijwe. Ibivugwa mu gika cya 5, bikurikizwa ku byerekeye ibinyamitende itatu n’ibinyamitende ine bifite moteri cyangwa bitayifite, bifite akazu k’umuyobozi.
b) Nyamara umuyobozi ashobora kwemerera umuntu umwe cyangwa benshi gufata umwanya mu gice cy’ikinyabiziga cyigenewe gutwara ibintu, iyo abona bishoboka kandi bidashobora kuvamo impamvu yatera impanuka. Agomba kuba yizeye ko ahantu hose umutekano w’abo atwaye udashobora guhungabana.
c) Ibimaze kuvugwa ntibikurikizwa n’abayobozi b’ibinyabiziga bikoreshwa mu mirimo ya gisirikare cyangwa ya gipolisi cyangwa mu mirimo y’abarwanya inkongi cyangwa y’abasukura imihanda.

articles.title: Uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe (Authorized Maximum Weights and Axle Loads)
Kugabanya uburemere ku miteme n'ibyapa C,7 (Weight reduction on bridges)
articles.content:
1. Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu ashobora: Kugabanya uburemere ntarengwa buteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 67, ku bice bimwe na bimwe by’umuhanda kimwe no ku mateme, ibyombo cyangwa ku bindi byubatswe ku nzira nyabagendwa ku buryo bukwiranye n’icyatuma ayo mayira y’ibyo byubatswe bitakwangirika no kurinda ibyago abagenda mu mihanda.
Igiteranyo cy’uburemere bwemewe kizagaragazwa ku cyapa N° C,7 gishinzwe ku mpera z’imihanda cyangwa hafi y’ibyo byubatseku muhanda byavuzwe haruguru.

2. Iyo uburebure ntarengwa bwemewe bwashizweho hakurikijwe ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 67 burenga toni eshatu, kimwe no ku modoka zose cyangwa romoruki byagenewe gutwara ibintu, ibiranga uburemere bw’ibinyabiziga n’ubw’ibyo bishobora kwikorera byandikishwa na nyirabyo mu rubavu rwabyo rw’iburyo ahagana imbere.
Ibyo bishobora kwandikishwa irangi kuri karisori cyangwa bikandikwa ku cyapa gifashe neza kuri karisori.
Inyuguti n’imibare bigomba kugira byibura santimetero 5 z’ubuhagarike (5 cm) n’umubyimba wabyo ukagira byibura mirimetero 5 (5 mm).
Ibyanditseho n’uko byandikwa bigomba guhuza n’ibiri ku rugero rwa 2 rw’ingereka ya 8 y’iri teka.
Ibimaze kuvugwa nti bikurikizwa:
a) Ku mashini zihinga;
b) Ku mashini zihariye zikoreshwa n’abapataniye imirimo;
c) Kuri za otobosi no kuzindi modoka nini zitwara abantu;
d) Ku byo ibinyabiziga bitwaye inyuma no ku tunyabiziga dukurura nk’utwikorera ingeri z’ibiti.

3. Iyo ubifitiye ububasha ashidikanya ku buremere bukubiye hamwe bw’ikinyabiziga, umuyobozi ategetse kumuba hafi no kumufasha mubyo agomba ku genzura bitagombye kurenza amasaha abiri (2 hours).

key_values.inscription_side: Right side towards front (urubavu rw'iburyo ahagana imbere)

articles.title: Ibyerekeye ibinyabiziga bikururana (Coupled vehicles applicability)
articles.content: Ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 57 kugeza kuya 68 z’iri teka bikurikizwa kuri buri kinyabiziga cyose kiri mubi kururana.

key_values.scope: Articles 57 to 68 apply to each vehicle in a combination

articles.title: Umubare ntarengwa w'ibinyabiziga bikururwa (Maximum number of towed vehicles and length)
Ibizirikisho n'iminyururu yo gukurura (Towing couplings and drawbars)
articles.content:
1. Iyo hagati y’uruhande rw’imbere rwa romoruki n’uruhande rw’inyuma rw’ikinyabiziga kiyikurura hari umwanya urenze metero 3 (3 m), ikibizirikanyije kigomba kugaragazwa:
- Ku manywa: N’agatambaro gatukura gafite byibura santimetero 50 z’uruhande (50 x 50 cm);
- Iyo amatara y’ikinyabiziga agomba gucanwa: n’ikimenyetso gisa n’icunga rihishije rigaragara mu mbavu keretse iyo ikibizirikanyije kimuritse.

2. Ibizirikisho by’iminyururu cyangwa by’insinga kimwe n’ibindi bizirikisho by’ingoboka bikoreshwa gusa igihe nta kundi umuntu yabigenza kandi nta kindi bigiriwe, uretse gusa kugira ngo ikinyabiziga kigere aho kigomba gukorerwa kandi nturenze na rimwe kilometero 20 mu isaha (20 km/h).
Ibyo bizirikisho bigomba kugaragazwa n’icyapa cyera cya mpande enye zingana zifite nibura santimetero 30 kuri buri ruhande (30 x 30 cm), kiri ku ruhande rw’imbere rw’ikinyabiziga gikurura.

3. Hanyuranyijwe n’ibivugwa mu gika cya 2 cy’iyi ngingo, iyo uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe bwa romoroki burenga ibiro 750 (750 kg) cyangwa icya kabiri cy’uburemere bw’ikinyabiziga gikurura kirimo ubusa kandi ibyuma bya feri bitifunga ubwabyo, mu gihe ikizirikisho cy’ingenzi gicitse, iyo romoruki igomba kuba ifite n’ikizirikisho cyo gutabara gikozwe mu minyururu cyangwa mu nsinga, kiyongera ku kizirikisho cy’ingenzi gituma ikurura kandi iyobora romoruki, bigatuma igihe ibyangombwa by’ingenzi biramutse bidakoze neza, bikurura iyo romoruki kandi bikayibuza no guta icyerekezo, bikanatuma icyo bifasheho kidakora hasi.
Igihe ibyangombwa by’ingenzi bicitse ikizirikisho cyo gutabara gikoreshwa gusa mu bihe biteganyijwe mu gika cya kabiri cy’iyi ngingo.

key_values.emergency_towing_sign: White square sign at least 30 x 30 cm on front towing vehicle

articles.title: Uruhushya rwo gutwara ibintu birenze uburumbarare (Special authorization for exceptional loads)
articles.content:
1. Gutwara ibintu bidashobora kugabanywamo ibice no kugendesha ibinyabiziga cyangwa za romoruki zikoreshwa mu gutwara ibyo bintu kandi ibiziranga bikaba birengeje ingero ntarengwa zashyizweho n’iteka, bitangirwa uruhushya na Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu amaze kuvuga ibyangombwa bigomba kuzuzwa kugira ngo rutangwe.
2. Iyo uruhushya rwasabwe rwerekeye ubugari, ubuhagarike cyangwa uburebure, bugomba kwandikwaho itariki, kandi byaba ngombwa, rukandikwaho amasaha ibyo bintu bizatwarirwaho kimwe n’aho bizanyuzwa.
3. Uruhushya rwandikwaho ibigomba gukorwa kugirango baborohereze urugendo kandi bagende ntacyo bikanga mu nzira no kugira ngo hatagira icyangiza inzira nyabagendwa, impande zayo, ibyubatseho, n’umutungo uyikikije.
4. Uwasabye uruhushya aruhabwa gusa ari uko yemeye gutanga indishyi n’amafaranga ashobora gukomoka kuri ubwo bwikorezi no gutanga bibaye ngombwa, amafaranga y’ingwate yemejwe muri urwo ruhushya.
5. Uruhushya rushobora guhabwa urusabye ku rugendo rumwe gusa, uretse igihe ibitwawe bifitiye koko rubanda akamaro.
Gutwara mu binyabiziga bigendera ku mihanda, rukururana, za gari ya moshi zirimo ubusa cyangwa zipakiye, bishobora kwakirwa impushya zemewe ku rugendo rumwe gusa cyangwa ku ngendo nyinshi. Ibivugwa mu gika cya mbere n’icya kane bikurikizwa kuri ubwo buryo bwo gutwara ibintu.

articles.title: Guhagarika ikinyabiziga kirenga ku mategeko y'uburemere (Enforcement and immobilisation)
articles.content: Iyo umuyobozi yaciye ku bivugwa ku ngingo ya 67 cyangwa ku byateganyijwe kugira ngo uruhushya rutangwe hakurikijwe ingingo ya 72, agomba gupakurura, kuzitura cyangwa guhagarika ikinyabiziga cye hafi hatuwe, bitagenze bityo ikinyabiziga kizahagarikwa.

key_values.action_on_infraction: Unload, secure or immobilize near inhabited area

articles.title: Feri z'imodoka, romoruki n'ibinyamitende (Braking systems)
articles.content:
1. Mu kubahiriza ibivugwa muri uyu mutwe:
d) Ijambo “Ibiziga by’umwihariko” bivuga ibinyabiziga biteganye cyangwa bijya gusa n’ibiteganye, uhereye ku murongo ugabanya ikinyabiziga mo kabiri mu burebure, niyo ibyo biziga byaba bidafungiye ku mutambiko umwe, kubwo umutambiko ukurikiyeho ugafatwa nk’aho ari imitambiko ibiri.
e) Ijambo “Feri y’urugendo” bivuga uburyo busanzwe bukoreshwa kugirango ikinyabiziga kigende buhoro cyangwa gihagarare.
f) Ijambo “Feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini” rivuga uburyo bukoreshwa kugirango ikinyabiziga kigume hamwe mu gihe umuyobozi atakirimwo, yaba ari romoruki, ngo igume hamwe mu gihe itagifatanye n’ikinyabiziga.
g) Ijambo “Feri yo gutabara” rivuga uburyo bukoreshwa kugira ngo ikinyabiziga kigende buhoro kandi gihagarare, igihe feri idakora neza.
h) Ijambo “Romoruki” rikoreshwa gusa kuri za romoruki zigenewe gukururwa n’imodoka.

2. Ikinyabiziga cyose cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikururana bigomba kugira uburyo bwo gufunga feri butunganye kugirango hagenzurwe imigendekere y’ikinyabiziga, kugihagarika kuburyo bwihuse kandi bwizerwa no kubuza kwikaraga kw’ikiziga n’ukw’ibiziga bifunze, uko imodoka yaba yikoreye kose cyangwa igeze ahacuramye cyangwa ahaterera.

3. Feri y’imodoka:
a) Buri modoka igomba kugira uburyo bwo gufunga feri bushobora gukoreshwa n’umuyobozi ku buryo bworoshye kandi butuma imiyoborere y’imodoka idahungabana kandi bigizwe na:
1° Feri y’urugendo: Ituma imodoka igenda buhoro kandi igahagarara kuburyo bwizewe bubangutse kandi nyabwo, n’uko imodoka yaba yikoreye kose, yaba igeze ahacuramye cyangwa ahaterera;
2° Feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini: Ituma imodoka iguma aho iri uko yaba yikoreye kose ku muzamuko cyangwa ku gacuri bya 16%, imyanya ya feri igomba gufata igakomeza kwegera kuburyo bw’ibyuma niyo umuyobozi yaba atarimo.
3° Feri yo gutabara: Ni feri ituma imodoka igenda buhoro kandi igahagarara, uko yaba yikoreye kose, ku burebure bugereranyije n’ubwo feri y’urugendo yaba idakora neza.
b) Uburyo bwo gufunga feri bushobora kugira ibice buhuriyeho mu gihe byibura bibiri mu biyikoresha bitandukanye.
c) Feri y’urugendo: Ni feri igomba gufunga ibiziga byose by’imodoka, nyamara ku modoka zifite imitambiko irenga ibiri, ibiziga by’umutambiko umwe bishobora kudafungwa.
d) Feri y’urugendo na feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini bigomba gufunga byibura umupira umwe wa buri ruhande rwo hirya no hino y’umurongo ugabanya imodoka mo kabiri mu burebure bwayo.
e) Feri y’urugendo na feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini zigomba gufunga imyanya yose ifashe ku biziga ku buryo buhoraho hakoreshejwe ibyuma bikomeye bihagije.
f) Nta mwanya n’umwe feri ifungiraho ushobora kurekurana n’ibiziga keretse:
1. Iyo kurekurana ari iby’akanya gato, nk’igihe cyo guhinduranya vitesi;
2. Iyo bireba feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini, ubwo kurekurana ntibishoboka bidakozwe n’umuyobozi;
3. Iyo kurekurana bireba feri y’urugendo cyangwa feri yo guhagarara, ufata feri bishobora no gukorwa ku buryo nyabwo bwavuzwe mu gika a) kibanza.

4. Feri ya za romoruki:
a) Buri romoruki uretse intoya, igomba kugira uburyo bwo gufata feri bukurikira:
1. Feri y’urugendo: feri ituma ikinyabiziga kigenda buhoro cyangwa gihagarara ku buryo bwemewe, bwihuse kandi nyabwo uko cyaba kikoreye kose cyangwa kigeze ahacuramye cyangwa ahaterera.
2. Feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini ituma romoruki iguma aho iri uko yaba yikoreye kose ku muzamuko cyangwa gacuri bya 16%, imyanya ya feri igomba gufata igakomeza kwegerana ku buryo bw’ibyuma.
Ibi ntibikurikizwa kuri za romoruki zidashobora kurekurana n’ibizikurura hadakoreshejwe ibikoresho, hapfa kuba hubahirijwe ibyerekeye feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini ku binyabiziga byose.
b) Ibyo byose bituma feri y’urugendo na feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini bishobora kugira ibice bihuriyeho.
c) Feri y’urugendo igomba gufunga ibiziga bya romoruki.
d) Feri y’urugendo igomba kuba ishobora gukoreshwa n’igitegeka feri y’urugendo y’ikinyabiziga gikurura.
Nyamara, iyo uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe bwa romoruki butarenga kg 3500 feri y’urugendo ishobora gukorwa ku buryo ikoreshwa gusa n’uburemere, ni ukuvuga ukwegerana konyine kwa romoruki n’ikinyabiziga gikurura (inertial braking).
e) Feri y’urugendo na feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini zigomba gufuga imyanya yose ifashe ku biziga ku buryo buhoraho hakoreshejwe ibyuma bihagije.
f) Uburyo bwo gufunga feri bugomba kuba buteye ku buryo romoruki yihagarika igihe ikyiziritse gicitse igenda (breakaway safety braking).
Nyamara ibi ntibikurikizwa kuri za romoruki zifite umutambiko umwe cyangwa iz’imitambiko ibiri itandukanyijwe n’umwanya utageze kuri metero, uburemere ntarengwa bwazo bwapfa gusa kuba butarenza kg 1500 keretse makuzungu n’ubwo kandi, habariwemo inyuma ikizizirikanye, zaba zifite ikindi cyuma cya kabiri kizifashe nkuko biteganywa mu ngingo ya 71, 3, y’iri teka.

5. Ibyerekeye feri y’ubukomatanye bw’ibinyabiziga bikururana:
Uretse ibivugwa ku gika cya 4 n’icya 4 by’iyi ngingo byerekeye imodoka na romoruki iri yonyine ibinyabiziga bikomatanye bigomba na none gukurikiza aya mategeko:
a) Ibyuma byose bituma feri ifata bifunze kuri buri kinyabiziga, bigomba kuba bikora kimwe.
b) Uko feri y’urugendo ikora kugomba kuba kumwe kandi ku gihe kimwe kuri buri kinyabiziga kizitse ibikomatanye;
c) Uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe bwa romoruki idafite feri y’urugendo ntibushobora kurenga ½ cy’uburemere bw’ikinyabiziga gikurura n’ubw’umuyobozi.

6. Ibyerekeye feri ya velomoteri, amapikipiki n’ibinyamitende 3 cyangwa 4:
Buri velomoteri n’ipikipiki, ikinyamitende 3 cyangwa 4, bigomba kugira ibyuma byo guhagarara kimwe nibura gifunga inziga z’inyuma indi ikaba ifunga byibura inziga z’imbere.
Iyo icyo kinyabiziga gifite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande, uruziga rwako ntirugomba feri.
Uburyo bwo gufunga feri bugomba gutuma ikinyabiziga kigenda buhoro cyangwa gihagarara ku buryo bwizewe, bwihuse kandi nyabwo uko cyaba cyikoreye kose cyangwa kigeze ahacuramye cyangwa ahaterera.

7. Ibivugwa kuva ku gika cya mbere kugeza ku gika cya gatandatu cy’iyi ngingo ntibikurikizwa:
a) Ku tumodoka tw’abana n’utw’ibimuga cyangwa tw’abarwayi tugendeshwa n’undi muntu;
b) K’utunyabiziga dusunikwa twikorera uburemere butarenga kg 150;
c) Kuri za romoruki zifite umutambiko umwe ngusa n’uburebure ntarengwa bwemewe butarenga kg 500 nabwo butarenga ½ cy’uburemere bwite bw’ikinyabiziga gikurura;
d) Ku binyabiziga bikururwa n’inyamaswa bifite ibizigabibiri byikoreye uburemere butarenze kilogarama 1.000 kandi ikibizirikanije kiba giteye kuburyo ikinyabiziga gihagarari icyarimwe n’inyamaswa igikurura.

articles.chapter_title: Amatara y'ibinyabiziga n'ibimenyetso biranga ibinyabiziga n'inyamaswa
articles.title: Amategeko rusange ku matara n'utugarurarumuri (General lighting rules)
articles.content:
1. Amatara yaburi kinyabiziga agomba kuba ateye kuburyo ntatara na rimwe cyangwa agarurarumuri bitukura byaboneka kuruhande rw’imbere rw’ikinyabiziga uretse itara ryo gusubira inyuma n’aranga icyerekezo.
2. Amatara n’utugarura urumuri bigomba gushyirwaho kuburyo ntagice na kimwe cy’ikikinyabiziga cyangwa cy’imizigo cyabangamira ibonesha nyabyo.
3. Ikinyabiziga ntigishobora kugira amatara abiri yubwoko bumwe kereka kubyerekeye itara ndanga mubyimbacyangwa itara ndanga burumbarare n’itararyerekana icyerekezo.
4. Iyo ikinyabiziga gifite amatara abiri cyangwa menshi y’ubwoko bumwe, ayo matara agomba kugira ibara rimwe n’ingufu zingana; kandi akagomba gushyirwaho ku buryo buteganye uhereye ku murongo ugabanya ikinyabiziga mo kabiri mu burebure bwacyo.
Ibimaze kuvugwa ntibikurikizwa ku byerekeye itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga nomero y’ikinyabiziga inyuma.
3. Utugarurarumuri turi kuruhande rw’imbere rw’ikinyabiziga tugomba gusa n’umweru, utw’inyuma tugasa n’umutuku, naho utwo mu mbavu tugasa n’umuhondo cyangwa icunga rihishije.
4. Amatara menshi y’ubwoko budahuje kimwe n’amatara n’utugarura rumuri bishobora gushyirwa ahantu hamwe cg mu kintu kimwe amurikiramo, buri tara na buri kagarurarumuli bipfa kuba bikurikije amategeko abyerekeye kandi ku buryo budashobora kujijisha.
5. Nta tara na rimwe cyangwa akagarura rumuri bishobora kuba bifunze ku buryo igice cyabyo cyo hasi cyane kimurika kitaba kiri hasi ya santimetero 40 (40 cm) kuva ku butaka, igihe ikinyabiziga kidapakiye. Ibimaze kuvugwa nti bikurikizwa ku matara kamenabihu no kw’itara ryo gusubira inyuma.
6. Gushyira amatara ku kinyabiziga kimwe cyangwa ku binyabiziga bikomatanye bigomba gukorwa kuburyo:
1. Amatara maremare, amatara magufi, amatara kamenabihu, amatara ndangambere, n’itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga ikinyabiziga ashobora gukoreshwa gusa mu gihe amatara ndanga ku kumpera z’ikinyabiziga cya nyuma mu bikomatanye nayo acanye;
2. Amatara ndangambere yakira rimwe buri gihe n’amagufi n’amatara kamenabihu y’imbere.
Nyamara, ibivugwa ku gika cya mbere ntibitegetswe ku matara maremare cg magufi, iyo akoreshejwe bashaka kwerekana ibimenyetso bimurika bivugwa mu ngingo ya 47 y’iri teka.

3. Itara ndanganyuma rigomba gushyirwa aherekeye inguni y'ibumoso y'ikinyabiziga.
4. Itara rigufi rishobora gushyirwa cyangwa kudashyirwa ku binyabiziga bifite moteri y'ingufu zitarenga santimetero kibe 50 (50 cc).
5. Amatara maremare n'ayo kubisikana ategetswe gukoreshwa gusa iyo umuvuduko w'ikinyabiziga kidapakiye kandi kigeze ahategamye ushobora kurenga kirometero 20 mu isaha.

2. Uretse amatara n'utugarurarumuri mu gika cya mbere k'iyi ngingo, hashobora gukoreshwa: amatara amurika kure cyane, amatara kamena-bihu, amatara yo gusubira inyuma, itara rishakisha ryera cyangwa ry'umuhondo, amatara y'icyatsi ryerekana ko ikinyabiziga kidakodeshejwe (taxi), amatara y'ibyanditswe by'ingendo (buses), amatara abiri asa n'icunga rihishije amyatsa agaragara muri metero 100 ku modoka zitwara abanyeshuri.

articles.chapter_title: Amatara y'ibinyabiziga n'ibimenyetso biranga ibinyabiziga n'inyamaswa
articles.title: Amatara ndanga n'utugarurarumuri (Position lights and reflectors specs)
articles.content:
1. Amatara ndanga yera cyangwa y’umuhondo ari imbere y’ikinyabiziga n’amatara ndanga atukura ari inyuma y’ikinyabiziga agomba ariko kuba adahumishije cyangwa ngo atere imbogamizi abandi bayobozi, kandi agaragara n’ijoro igihe ijuru rikeye, muri metero 300 nibura uhereye imbere n’inyuma h’ikinyabiziga, kamenabihu yo ni muri metero 100.
Nyamara, ku byerekeye amatara y’inyuma y’ibinyamitende na velomoteri iyo ntera iba gusa metero 100.

3. Utugarurarumuri tugomba nijoro, igihe rikeye, kubonwa n’umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga kiri muri metero 150, iyo tumuritswe n’amatara y’urugendo y’icyo kinyabiziga.
Utugarurarumuri turi inyuma ya za romoruki tugomba gusa n’igishushanyo cya mpande eshatu zingana zifite kuva kuri santimetero 15 kugeza kuri 20 kandi rimwe mu masonga yayo ireba hejuru, uruhande ruteganye naryo rukaba rutambitse.
Romoruki zifite ubugari ntarengwa bwa santimetero 80 zishobora gushyirwaho akagarurarumuri kamwe gusa, iyo zikuruwe n’ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga ku ruhande.
Utugarurarumuri turi ku kindi kinyabiziga kitari romoruki ntidushobora gusa n’igishushanyo cya mpande eshatu.

4. Umuguno w’inyuma w’igice kimurika cy’amatara mato ndanga mbere na ndanga nyuma kimwe n’icy’utugarurarumuri tw’imbere n’utw’inyuma, igomba kuba ahatarenga santimetero 40 ku mpande z’ubugari ntarengwa bw’ikinyabiziga.
1. Ahari hejuru cyane y’ubuso bumurika h’amatara mato ndanga mbere na ndanga nyuma, ntihashobora kuba aharenze metero 1 na santimetero 90 hejuru y’ubutaka, iyo ikinyabiziga kidapakiye. Ku byerekeye utugarura rumuri ubwo buhagarike ntibushobora kurenga metero 1 na santimetero 20.
2. Amatara ndanga burumbarare agomba kubonwa nijoro, igihe ijuru rikeye n’umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga kiri ku ntera ya metero 200 nibura.
3. Amatara yo guhagarara umwanya munini agomba kohereza imbere urumuri rwera, n’urutukura inyuma, kandi akubahiriza ibyangombwa bituma amatara ndanga mbere na ndanga nyuma agaragara.

articles.chapter_title: Amatara y'ibinyabiziga n'ibimenyetso biranga ibinyabiziga n'inyamaswa
articles.title: Amatara maremare n'amagufi (Driving and passing headlights)
articles.content:
1. Amatara maremare y’ibara ryera cyangwa ry’umuhondo agomba nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye, kumurika mu muhanda ku ntera ya metero 100 nibura imbere y’ikinyabiziga.
Iyo ntera ingana na metero 75 ku binyabiziga bifite moteri itarengeje ingufu ligera kuri santimetero kibe 125.
Imiguno y’inyuma y’igice kimurika cy’amatara maremare ntigomba na rimwe iyo ayo matara agizwe n’umubare utari igiharwe, kwegera impera z’ubugari bwose no ku mikaba y’inyuma y’igice kimurika cy’amatara magufi.
Iyo ntera ingana na metero 15 ku binyabiziga bifite moteri itarengeje ingufu zigera kuri santimetero kibe 125. Umuguno wo hejuru w'igice kimurika cy'amatara magufi ntushobora gusumba metero 1 na santimetero 20 (1.20 m) uhereye ku butaka igihe ikinyabiziga kidapakiye.
Ku binyabiziga bigomba kugira kuri buri ruhande amatara abiri magufi, isonga ry’igice kimurika uhereye ku murongo ugabanya ikinyabiziga mo kabiri mu burebure bwacyo ntigishobora kujya hirya ya santimetero 40 ku isonga y’ubugari bw’ikinyabiziga. Imodoka ntishobora kugira amatara arenze abiri magufi.
4. Iyo ikinyabiziga gifite itara ryo gusubira inyuma, iryo tara rigomba kuba ryarakozwe kandi rigashyirwaho ku buryo ryohereza urumuri rwera cyangwa rw’umuhondo, mu ntera irenga metero 20 kandi rudahuma cyangwa ngo rubangamire abandi bayobozi. Igituma iryo tara ryaka kigomba kuba ku buryo ryaka gusa iyo usubira inyuma bitangiye.

articles.chapter_title: Amatara y'ibinyabiziga n'ibimenyetso biranga ibinyabiziga n'inyamaswa
articles.title: Itara ryo guhagarara (Stop lights / brake lights)
articles.content:
1. Itara ryo guhagarara ritukura, ridahumisha, kugaragara nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye nibura ni mu ntera ya metero 150, no ku manywa igihe cy’umucyo mu ntera nibura ya metero 20.
Iyo itara ryo guhagarara riri hamwe n’itara ndanga nyuma cyangwa rifatanye naryo, rigomba kugira urumuri rubonesha cyane kurusha iryo tara rifatanye naryo.
2. Ahari hejuru cyana h’ubuso buboneka kw’itara ryo guhagarara ntihashobora gusumba metero 1 na santimetero 55 uhereye ku butaka, igihe ikinyabiziga kidapakiye.
3. Iyo ikinyabiziga gifite gusa itara rimwe ryo guhagarara, iryo tara rigomba gushyirwa mu murongo ugabanyije ikinyabiziga mo kabiri ku buryo bungana mu burebure bwacyo cyangwa hagati y’uwo murongo n’impembe y’ibumoso y’ubugari ntarengwa by’ikinyabiziga.
4. Itara ryo guhagarara rigomba kwaka iyo feri y’urugendo ikoreshejwe.

key_values.activation: Automatically activates when service brake is applied

articles.chapter_title: Amatara y'ibinyabiziga n'ibimenyetso biranga ibinyabiziga n'inyamaswa
articles.title: Amatara ndangacyerekezo (Direction indicator lights / turn signals)
articles.content:
1. Amatara ndanga cyerekezo agomba kuba agizwe n’ibintu bifashe ku rumuri rumyatsa, biringaniye ku buryo bigira umubare utari igiharwe, ku mpande z’imbere n’inyuma z’ikinyabiziga, amatara y’imbere akaba yera cyangwa umuhondo, ay’inyuma akaba atukura cyangwa asa n’icunga rihishije. Ayo matara ashobora gufatanywa n’amatara ndanga n’amatara yo guhagarara.
2. Aho amatara ndanga cyerekezo ashyirwa ku kinyabiziga hagomba kuba hateye ku buryo ibyerekezo byerekanwa nayo matara bibonwa ku manywa na n’ijoro, haba imbere cyangwa inyuma h’ikinyabiziga, n’abagenzi bakeneye kumenya imigendere y’ikinyabiziga.
3. Amatara ndanga cyerekezo agomba kugaragara n’ijoro, igihe ijuru rikeye, mu ntera nibura ya metero 150 no ku manywa igihe cy’umucyo, mu ntera ya metero 20.
4. Ahari hejuru y’itara ndanga cyerekezo ntihashobora kuba aharenze metero imwe na santimetero 90 (1.90 m) hejuru y’ubutaka igihe ikinyabiziga kidapakiye.
5. Imikorere y’imyatsa igomba kuba inshuro 90 mu munota, hashobora kwiyongeraho cyangwa kugabanukaho inshuro zimyatsa 30 (90 ± 30 flashes/min, i.e., 60 to 120 flashes/min).

articles.chapter_title: Amatara y'ibinyabiziga n'ibimenyetso biranga ibinyabiziga n'inyamaswa
articles.title: Itara ribonesha puraki (Registration plate light)
articles.content:
Itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga nimero rigomba kuba ryera, kandi n’ijoro, igihe ijuru rikeye rigomba gutuma izo numero zisomerwa muri metero 20 nibura inyuma y’ikinyabiziga iyo gihagaze.
Iryo tara ntirishobora kwohereza inyuma y’ikinyabiziga urumuri ruturutse mu isoko yarwo.

articles.chapter_title: Amatara y'ibinyabiziga n'ibimenyetso biranga ibinyabiziga n'inyamaswa
articles.title: Amatara y'inyamaswa n'ibinyabiziga bikururwa n'inyamaswa (Animal drawn vehicles and herds lighting)
articles.content:
1. Iyo amatara yateganyijwe mu ngingo ya 76 adashobora gushyirwa ku kinyabiziga bitewe n’imiterere yacyo cyangwa n’imizigo gitwaye, umuherekeza agomba gutwara ku ruhande rw’imberere kandi ibumoso bw’ikinyabiziga, itara ryera cyangwa ry’umuhondo rimurika ryerekeza imbere, naho umuherekeza wa kabiri agatwara ku rundi ruhande rw’inyuma ibumoso bw’ikinyabiziga, itara ritukura rimurika ryerekeza inyuma.
2. Kuva bwije kugeza bukeye umuyobozi w’inyamaswa zikurura cyangwa izikorera ibintu zitaziritse cyangwa amatungo, biri mu nzira nyabagendwa agomba gutwara itara ry’urumuri rwera cyangwa rw’umuhondo ribonesha ku mpande zose.
3. Iyo umukumbi ugizwe n’amatungo maremare arenze ane cyangwa amatungo magufi arenze atandatu ugaragazwa: n’itara ry’urumuri ryera cyangwa umuhondo ritwawe imbere y’umukumbi, n’itara ry’urumuri rutukura ritwawe inyuma y’uwo mukumbi.

key_values.front_light: White or yellow facing forward on left side
key_values.rear_light: Red facing backward on left side

articles.title: Amahoni n'inzogera (Audible warning devices / horns)
articles.content:
1. Ibinyabiziga bigiye kuvugwa bigomba kuba bifite ibikoresho by’ihoni byumvikanira:
- Ku ntera ya metero 100 ku binyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri, iyo ntera igashobora kungana na metero 50, iyo umuvuduko w’ibinyabiziga bidapakiye udashobora kurenga kirometero 50 mu isaha ahategamye;
- Ku ntera ya metero 20 kuri velomoteri.
Amahoni y’ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri agomba kohereza ijwi ry’injyana imwe, rikomeza kandi ridacengera amatwi.
2. Ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa kimwe n’ibinyabiziga bikora mu muhanda, bishobora kugira ihoni ridasanzwe ridahuje n’ibiteganywa muri iki gika uretse ihoni riteganywa mu gika cya mbere.

articles.title: Uturebanyuma (Rear-view mirrors)
articles.content:
Ikinyabiziga cyose kigendeshwa na moteri kigomba kugira nibura akarebanyuma gateye kuburyo umuyobozi uri ku ntebe ashobora kugenzura ibigendera mu muhanda inyuma n’ibumoso bw’ikinyabiziga nko kubona ikindi kinyabiziga cyatangiye kumunyuraho ibumoso. Ni nako bitegetswe ku kinyabiziga gikururwa n’inyamaswa gifite akazu k’umuyobozi.
Iyo imiterere y’ikinyabiziga cyangwa ibyo cyikoreye bidatuma akarebanyuma kari ku kazu k’ikinyabiziga gashobora gukora neza umurimo kagenewe, uturebanyuma tugomba gushyirwa kuri buri rubavu rw’ikinyabiziga.

key_values.mandatory_mirrors: Interior rearview mirror and exterior driver side mirror
key_values.two_side_mirrors_required: When interior view is obstructed by vehicle body or cargo

articles.title: Ibirahuri n'agahanagura-kirahuri (Windshields and wipers)
articles.content:
1. Ku kinyabiziga cyose no kuri buri romoruki:
a) Ibintu bibonerana bigize igice cy’inyuma k’ikinyabiziga habariwemo ikirahuri gihagarika umuyaga cyangwa ibigize ikibambasi cy’imbere bigomba kuba bikoze ku buryo iyo bimenetse ibyago byo gukomereka byagabanuka uko bishoboka kose;
b) Ibirahuri byo guhagarika umuyaga bigomba kuba bikozwe mu bintu bibonerana bidacuya kandi bikaba bikoze ku buryo bidahindura isura y’ikireberwamo kandi mu gihe bimenetse, umuyobozi agakomeza kubona bihagije inzira nyabagendwa.
2. Ikinyabiziga cyose kigendeshwa na moteri gifite igihagarika-muyaga uretse amapikipiki, kigomba kugira nibura agahanagura-kirahuri kamwe, ku buryo mu kugakoresha bidasaba umuyobozi guhora agakoresha. Agahanagura-kirahuri kagomba guhanagura neza ubuso buhagije kugira ngo umuyobozi ashobore kubona neza umuhanda yicaye mu ntebe.
4. Buri kinyabiziga gitegetswe kugira nibura agahanagura-kirahuri kamwe kigomba no kugira akoza-kirahuri gatuma umuyobozi abona neza cyane kandi buri gihe arebeye mu gihagarika-muyaga.

key_values.wiper_requirement: At least one automatic windshield wiper

articles.title: Umwotsi, imyuka n'insaku z'imodoka (Exhaust emissions and silencers)
articles.content:
1. Ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri na velomoteri bigomba kuba bikoze ku buryo bitagenda bimena bidasanzwe amavuta binavubura ibyotsi bicumba, bicumba umwotsi, uretse moteri yakijwe, kandi bitabangamiye rubanda cyangwa ngo bitere ubwoba inyamaswa kubera urusaku, ibyo ari byo byose ntibishobora gusakuza birengeje ingero ntarengwa zivugwa ku mugereka wa 13 w’iri teka.
2. Moteri yose ikoreshwa n’ubushyuhe igomba kugira impombo yohereza imyotsi ku buryo nyabwo idasakuza kandi umuyobozi akaba atashobora kuyibuza gukora neza mu rugendo. Impombo yohereza ibyotsi idafite akagabanya rusaku irabujijwe kimwe n’ikindi gikorwa kigamije gukuraho cyangwa kugabanya imikorere myiza y’impombo yohereza imyotsi idasakuza. Isonga y’impombo yohereza ibyotsi ntigomba kwerekezwa iburyo bw’ikinyabiziga.
3. Mu nsisiro, birabujijwe gusakurisha moteri igihe ikinyabiziga gihagaze moteri yaka.

key_values.silencer_mandatory: Efficient silencer required, bypass/cutout strictly forbidden
key_values.exhaust_direction: Must not point towards the right side of vehicle
key_values.urban_idling_noise: Revving engine while stationary in built-up areas is forbidden

articles.title: Inziga n'amapine (Tires and wheels)
articles.content:
1. Ibiziga by’ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri n’ibya velomoteri kimwe n’ibya romoruki zabyo bigomba kuba byambaye inziga zihagwa zifite amano n’ubujyakuzimu butari munsi ya milimetero imwe (1 mm) ku mirongo yabyo yose n’ubudodo bwabyo ntibugire ahantu na hamwe bugaragara kandi ntibigire aho byacitse bikomeye mu mpande zabyo.
Nyamara ibimaze kuvugwa ntibikurikizwa ku binyabiziga bidapakiye kandi bitajya birenza umuvuduko wa kirometero 25 ahategamye.
3. Inziga z’ibiziga zigomba kugira imirongo itagira utunogo n’udushundu dushobora kwangiza inzira nyabagendwa.
Inziga zishobora gushyirwaho iminyururu irwanya ubunyerere, ibyo bikorwa gusa kugirango kuva ahantu hari urwondo cyangwa hanyerera bidasanzwe bishoboke.
3. Birabujijwe kugenza ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri na za romoruki zikururwa nabyo, iyo ibiziga byambaye inziga zidahagwa, cyangwa inziga zikururuka zifite umubyimbi uri hasi ya santimetero 4 (4 cm) cyangwa zifite ubugari, aho bwabarirwa hose, budashyitse kuri 2/3 by’ubugari bw’uruziga rukiri rushya.
4. Ibivugwa mu gika cya 3, ntibikurikizwa:
a) Ku binyabiziga bihinga, iyo bigendeshwa mu karere katarenga kirometero 25 uvuye aho ziba;
b) Ku bikoresho bidasanzwe bikoreshwa n’abapatanyi b’imirimo, biva aho bibikwa bijya aho bikoreshwa cyangwa iyo bitahutse cyangwa se iyo byimutse aho byakoreraga bijya gukora ahandi, kimwe no ku binyabiziga bidasanzwe bibunza mu masoko kugira ngo kigumye gukora neza zikozwe muri kawucu, iyo ugupakira kw’ibyo bikoresho n’ibinyabiziga bidasanzwe ku binyabiziga bisanzwe bigendera mu muhanda byatera imbogamizi cyangwa impanuka.
Nyamara, ibinyabiziga binyuranye byavuzwe mu bika a) na b) bishobora kunyuzwa mu nzira nyabagendwa gusa iyo bidashobora kuyangiza.

key_values.snow_chains_or_mud_chains: Permitted only on slippery mud or ice

articles.title: Ibikoresho by'umutekano n'ubwirinzi (Safety equipment, warning triangle, first aid kit, seatbelts)
articles.content:
1. Buri kinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri kigomba kugira ibyuma boyobora bikomeye bituma umuyobozi akata ikinyabiziga cye ku buryo bworoshye, bwihuse kandi bwizewe.
2. Buri modoka igomba kugira uburyo bwo gusubira inyuma ku ntebe y’umuyobozi.
3. Buri kinyabiziga gishobora kurenza umuvuduko wa kilometero 40 mu isaha kigomba kugira icyerekana umuvuduko (compteur de vitesse) kiri aho umuyobozi areba kandi kigahora kitabwaho kugira ngo kigumye gukora neza.
4. Buri modoka yagenewe gutwara abantu, ariko umubare wabo ntarengwa ukaba munsi ya 6, umuyobozi abariwemo, igomba kugira imikandara yo kurinda ibyago igenewe umuyobozi n’umugenzi wicaye ku ntebe y’imbere. Ishobora no kugira imikandara ku zindi ntebe z’inyuma. Ibiranga imikandara yo kurinda ibyago bigenwa na Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu.
5. Buri kinyabiziga kigomba kugira ibi bikurikira:
a) Icyapa kiburira cya mpandeshatu zingana na santimetero 40 nibura buri ruhande (40 cm), imikaba y’ibara ritukura ya santimetero 5 nibura z’ubugari (5 cm), nta ndiba cyangwa bifite indiba y’ibara rigaragara, imikaba y’ibara ritukura ikaba ibengerana cyangwa ifite umusozo ngarurarumuri, byose hamwe bikaba bishobora guhagarikwa ku buryo bufashe (triangled'avertissement);
b) Agahago k’ubutabazi karimo byibura ibipfuko 4 bitanduza byagenewe buri muntu, udufashisho tw’ibipfuko 4 cyangwa ibikwasi 4 bitifunga, agacupa k’imiti karimo umuti wica mikorobi, inyandiko “ubutabazi bwihutirwa mu gihe hategerejwe muganga” n’inyandiko “Gufasha guhumeka umunwa ku wundi”.
6. Buri modoka igomba kugira ikintu kiyibuza kwibwa gituma itava aho iri cyangwa kigafunga icyuma cyayo cy’ingenzi igihe ihagaritswe igihe kirekire (antivol).
7. Ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri kiriho ibyuma ntamemwa cyangwa ikindi cyose gituma ikoreshwa mu gutera cyangwa kwitabara ntigishobora kugenda mu nzira nyabagendwa kidafite uruhushya rwihariye rwa Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu cyangwa umuhagarariye.
Ibimaze kuvugwa ntibikurikizwa ku binyabiziga by’ingabo z’igihugu.
8. Birabujijwe kwongera ku mpande z’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri cyangwa velomoteri imitako cyangwa ibindi bifite imigongo cyangwa ibirenga k’umubyimba bitari ngombwa kandi bishobora gutera ibyago abandi bagendera mu nzira nyabagendwa.
9. Uretse igihe gikururwa n’ikindi kinyabiziga, nta kinyabiziga gifite moteri gishobora kugenda mu mihanda ahamanuka, igihe moteri itaka cyangwa igihe vitensi idakora (coasting in neutral).

key_values.seatbelts_required: Vehicles carrying under 6 persons (driver and front passenger)

articles.title: Kubahiriza amategeko ku binyabiziga byose (General compliance of all vehicles)
articles.content:
Haseguriwe amategeko ateganywa n’ingingo ya 59, 70-2 n’iya 72, nta kinyabiziga na kimwe gishobora kujyanwa cyangwa gukomeza kugendeshwa mu nzira nyabagendwa niba kidakurikije amategeko y’igice cya I cy’iri teka.
Nyamara ibinyabiziga bijyanwe ku muhanda hatarashira igihe cy’imyaka 2 iri teka ritangiye gukurikizwa ntabwo birebwa n’ibivugwa ku ngingo ya 80-1, 85-1, 85-3, 88-4 na 88-5.

articles.title: Ibinyabiziga by'ingabo z'igihugu (Military vehicles exemptions)
articles.content: Ingingo ya 57, 61, 70, 71-1 kimwe n’ingingo ya 76, igihe ivuga itara ryo guhagarara n’amatara yerekana icyerekezo ntizikurikizwa ku binyabiziga by’ingabo z’igihugu, iyo imyubahirizwe yazo ibangamiye imiterere cyangwa umurimo w’umwanya muto cyangwa uzatinda by’ikinyabiziga.

articles.title: Ibyiciro by'ibimenyetso n'ububasha bwabyo (Hierarchy and categories of road signals)
articles.content:
1. Ibimenyetso bigenga uburyo bwo kugendera mu muhanda birimo ibyiciro bitatu:
a) Ibyapa;
b) Ibimenyetso bimurika;
c) Ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda.
2. Ibitegekwa byerekanwa n’amatara n’ibimenyetso bimurika birusha ububasha amategeko agenga ibitambuka mbere, ibitegekwa byerekanwa n’ibyapa bigenga ibigomba guhita mbere kimwe n’ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda.
3. Bitabangamiye ibikurikizwa mu ngingo ya 5, igika cya 6, abagendera mu nzira nyabagendwa bagomba kubahiriza ibitegekwa n’ibyapa, ibimenyetso bimurika n’ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda, n’iyo bitegetswe aho bageze bisa n’aho binyuranye n’andi mategeko agenga ibigendera mu muhanda.
4. Ishyirwaho ry’ibimenyetso rigenwa na Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu ku mihanda y’Igihugu n’iy’Imigi, rikagengwa na nyanama z’uturere ku byerekeye imihanda y’uturere.

hierarchy: 4. Road surface markings (Ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda)
key_values.sign_placing_authority: Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu (national/urban), Inama z'Uturere (district roads)

articles.title: Ibyiciro by'ibyapa no kubishinga (Categories of road signs and mounting specs)
Ibyapa biburira ibyago n'ibyo gutambuka mbere (Danger warning and priority signs)
articles.content:
1. Ibyapa biburira bibereyeho kumenyesha umugenzi ko hari icyago, bikerekana imiterere yacyo kandi bikamutegeka ubwitonzi budasanzwe kugira ngo imigenzereze ye ihure n’imiterere n’ububi bw’icyago cyerekanywe.
Naho ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere bibereyeho kumenyesha abagendera mu nzira nyabagendwa amategeko yihariye yo gutambuka mbere mu inkomane, ibyo byapa byose bishobora kugira ibyo bibuza.
2. Ibyapa biburira n’ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere bishushanyije ku mugereka wa mbere w’iri teka hamwe n’ibigereranyo byerekana imiterere y’icyago bimeze nka mpandeshatu ndinganire ifite ubuso bwera buzengurutswe n’ibara ritukura, uretse ibapa n° A, 28, a, b, na C; A, 30; A, 31; B.2 a na b; B4; B5; B6 na B7a na b.

articles.title: Aho gushinga ibyapa biburira (Placement distance of warning signs)
articles.content:
1. Ibyapa biburira ibyago n’ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere bishyirwa iburyo hakurikijwe ibyerekezo abagenzi bireba baganamo bitewe n’imiterere y’aho hantu icyapa cya kabiri kimeze nk’icya mbere cyashyizwe iburyo gishobora gushyirwa ibumoso.
2. Ahatari mu nsisiro, ibyapa biburira n’ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere bigomba gushyirwa mu ntera kuva kuri metero 150 kugeza kuri 200 (150 m to 200 m) y’ahantu habi byerekana. Iyo bitewe n’imiterere y’ahantu intera itandukanye icyapa n’ahantu habi iri munsi ya metero 150 ku buryo bugaragara, iyo ntera yerekanishwa icyapa cy’inyongera n° F, 1.
3. Hanyuranyijwe n’ibivugwa mu gika cya 2 cy’iyi ngingo:
a) Ibyapa n° A, 22, B1 na B2 bigomba gushyirwa hafi cyane hashobotse y’amasangano byerekana, buri cyapa gishobora kubanzirizwa n’ikindi nkacyo gishizwe ku ntera irenzeho uhereye ku isangano kandi ikarangwa n’icyapa cy’inyongera n° F, 1;
b) Ibyapa n° B, 28 a, A, 28b, na B2 bigomba gushyirwa, kimwe muri metero 150 ikindi muri metero 100, ikindi muri metero 50 uhereye ku masangano y’inzira nyabagendwa n’umuhanda wa gariyamoshi;
c) Ibyapa n° B, 7a na B, 7b bigomba gushyirwa ku ruhande rw’iburyo bw’amasangano y’inzira nyabagendwa n’umuhanda wa gariyamoshi biranga.
4. Iyo ahantu icyago cyaranzwe kiri ari harehare, uburebure bw’igice cy’inzira nyabagendwa icyo cyago kirimo bushobora kwerekanwa n’icyapa cy’inyongera n° F, 2.
5. Mu nsisiro, ibyapa biburira bigomba gushyirwa iruhande neza y’ahantu habi. Nyamara, ibyapa A, 6; 11 na A, 16 bigomba gushyirwa ku ntera iringaniye y’ahantu habi kandi iyo ntera igomba kwerekanwa n’icyapa n° F, 1.
6. Iyo icyapa kiburira gishinze aho inzira nyabagendwa irasukira, icyapa cy’inyongera kigizwe n’akarangacyerekezo kirabura gashobora kwerekana icyerekezo cy’ahantu habi, iyo aho hantu hari kuri iyo nzira nyabagendwa.

key_values.built_up_area_placement: Immediate vicinity of hazard (iruhande neza y'ahantu habi)

articles.title: Icyapa A, 22 (Roundabout sign restrictions)
articles.content: Icyapa n° A, 22 gishobora gushyirwa ku nzira nyabagendwa gusa iyo andi mayira arasukira mu masangano ariho icyapa n° B, 1; B, 1; B, 2.a; cyangwa B, 2, b.

key_values.condition: Requires Yield (B1) or STOP (B2) on all entering branch roads

articles.title: Icyago kiterekanywe n'ikigereranyo (Unspecified hazards)
articles.content: Icyago kiterekanywe n’ikigereranyo kiri k’umugereka wa mbere w’iri teka gishobora kurangwa n’icyapa cy’inyongera cyerekana icyo cyago, gishobora kandi kwerekanwa hakoreshejwe ikigereranyo kiboneye kitari mu mugereka wavuzwe.

key_values.rule: Unspecified dangers may be depicted with custom symbol or additional panel on sign A, 28 (other dangers)

articles.title: Ibyapa bibuza n'ibitegeka (Prohibitory and mandatory signs shape/color)
articles.content:
1. Ibyapa byereka abagenda ibyo babujijwe cyangwa bategetswe:
Bimeze nk’ingasire (circular/round), iyo ngasire izengurutswe n’ibara ritukura kandi ubuso bukera iyo igihe icyapa kibuza; Uretse ibyerekeye ibyapa bibuza guhagarara umwanya muto cyangwa munini bifite ubuso bw’ubururu. Ingasire igira ibara ry’ubururu iyo icyapa gitegeka.
2. Ibigereranyo bisiganura imiterere y’ikibuzwa cyangwa y’igitegekwa bishushanyije mu migereka ya 2 na 3 y’iri teka.
3. Ibyapa by’inyongera bishobora kumenyesha ubugerure cyangwa amarangametegeko rusange cyangwa ibibujijwe cyangwa ibitegetswe byihariye.

key_values.prohibitory_sign: Circular, white background, red border (parking prohibition has blue background)

articles.title: Aho ibyapa bibuza n'ibitegeka bikurikizwa (Zone of application of regulatory signs)
articles.content: Ibyapa bibuza n’ibitegeka bikurikizwa gusa mu gice cy’inzira nyabagendwa kiri hagati y’aho bishinze n’inkomane ikurikiye ku ruhande rw’inzira bishinzeho.

key_values.zone_of_application: From the sign up to the next intersection on the side where mounted

articles.title: Gushinga ibyapa bibuza guhagarara (Mounting parking prohibition signs)
articles.content:
1. Ibyapa bibuzwa bishyirwa iburyo hakurikijwe icyerekezo abagenzi bireba baganamo, bitewe n’imiterere y’aho hantu icyapa cya kabiri kimeze nk’icya mbere cyashizwe iburyo, gishobora gushyirwa ibumoso.
2. Ibyapa n° C, 20a (guhagarara umwanya munini babisikana) na C, 20b (kubuza guhagarara umwanya muto no guhagarara umwanya munini babisikana) bigomba gushyirwa kuri buri ruhande rw’inzira bigenewe, bikaba ari umubare uhagije kugirango bishobore kugaragara neza kuva ku cyapa kimwe kugeza ku kindi.
Nta na rimwe intera iri hagati y’ibyapa bibiri byavuzwe ishobora kurenga metero 100 (100 m).

articles.title: Ibyapa by'inyongera biranga iherezo ry'ibibuzwa (Arrows extending/ending parking prohibitions)
articles.content: Hanyuranyijwe n’ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 98, ibibujijwe biri ku byapa n° C, 18 (kubuza guhagarara umwanya munini) na N° C, 19 (kubuza guhagarara umwanya muto no guhagarara umwanya munini) bishobora kugarukira mu ntera iri hagati y’ibyapa bibiri bivuzwe haruguru byuzuzwa n’ibyapa by’inyongera bibiri: kimwe ni akarangacyerekezo k’umukara gahagaze gafite isonga rireba hejuru, ikindi ni akarangacyerekezo k’umukara gafite isonga ireba hasi.

articles.title: Umubare w'ibigereranyo ku ngasire imwe (Max symbols per circular sign)
articles.content: Iyo ibibuzwa byinshi byubahirizwa ahantu hamwe, ibigereranyo bibyerekeye bishobora gushyirwa hamwe ku ngasire imwe. Nyamara umubare w’ibigereranyo biteraniye ku ngasire imwe ntushobora kurenga bitatu (max 3).

articles.section_title: Ibimenyetso bimurika byerekana uko bagenda mu muhanda
articles.title: Amatara y'ibimenyetso bimurika (Traffic light signals meaning)
articles.content:
1. Amatara y’ibimenyetso bimurika ku buryo bw’amatara atatu asobanuye atya:
a) Itara ritukura rivuga: Birabujijwe kurenga icyo kimenyetso;
b) Itara ry’umuhondo: Gutambuka umurongo wo guhagarara umwanya muto, cyangwa igihe uwo murongo werekana udahari icyo kimenyetso ubwacyo, keretse igihe ryatse akiri hafi cyane ku buryo yaba atagishoboye guhagarara mu buryo butamuteza ibyago; nyamara iyo ikimenyetso kiri mu masangano umuyobozi arenze umurongo wo guhagarara cyangwa ikimenyetso muri ubwo buryo, ashobora kwambukiranya amasangano gusa ari uko atateza abandi ibyago;
c) Itara ry’icyatsi rivuga: uburenganzira bwo kurenga icyo kimenyetso.
2. Itara ritukura, itara ry’umuhondo rimyatsa n’iry’icyatsi kibisi, ashobora gusimburwa uko akurikirana na kamwe cyangwa uturangacyerekezo tw’itara ritukura, iry’umuhondo cyangwa icyatsi kibisi.
Utwo turangacyerekezo dusobanura kimwe n’amatara ariko icyo tubuza cyangwa icyo dutangira uburenganzira kigarukira ku byerekezo byerekanwa n’utwo turangacyerekezo.
3. Iyo itara rimwe cyangwa menshi y’inyongera agaragazwa n’akarangacyerekezo kamwe cyangwa twinshi ducaniwe rimwe n’itara ritukura cyangwa ry’umuhondo, uturangacyerekezo tuvuga uburenganzira bwo gukomeza urugendo gusa mu byerekezo byerekanwa n’utwo turangacyerekezo upfa kureka abandi bayobozi bakurikije amategeko kimwe n’abanyamaguru bagahita.
4. Iyo mu itara harimo ishusho y’umunyamaguru imuritswe cyangwa y’igare ibyo bireba gusa abanyamaguru cyangwa abayobozi b’amagare n’aba velomoteri y’imitende ibiri.
5. Amatara atukura n’ay’icyatsi kibisi y’ibimenyetso bimurika by’amabara abiri bisobanura kimwe n’amatara ahuje ayaka ku buryo butatu. Iyo yakiye rimwe asobanura kimwe n’itara ry’umuhondo mu buryo bwakamo amabara atatu.
Ibimenyetso bimurika ku buryo bw’amabara abiri bishyirwaho nk’abanyamaguru; muri icyo gihe itara ritukura n’iry’icyatsi kibisi asobanura uko akurikiranye ko bibujijwe n’uko byemewe kwinjira mu muhanda, urugero: kurangira kwemererwa n’uko itara ry’icyatsi kibisi rimyatsa.
6. Iyo ikimenyetso kimurika cyagenewe ibinyabiziga kidakora, itegeko rigenga gutambuka mbere kw’iburyo ritarakurikizwa, keretse iyo hari icyapa cyerekana uturutse inzira iyi n’iyi ariwe uhita mbere y’abaturutse mu zindi.
7. Iyo ikimenyetso kimurika cyagenewe ibinyabiziga bihagaze hakomeje gukora amatara atukura ku yindi nzira, abayobozi bagenda mu nzira nyabagendwa, abo ikimenyetso kimurika cyakomeje kwaka bashobora kurenga icyo kimenyeto bapfa gusa kubigirana ubwitonzi budahuga no kubanza kumenya, bakurikije nk’ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 15 n’iya 26, ko batatera ibyago cyangwa imbogamizi abandi bagenzi bo mu nzira nyabagendwa.

Amatara y’inyongera agizwe n’akarangacyerekezo k’ibara ry’icyatsi kibisi, ashyirwa munsi cyangwa iruhande rw’itara ry’icyatsi kibisi.

- Itara ritukura ryaka nyuma y’itara ry’umuhondo;

c) Ku bimenyetso by’uburyo bw’amatara abiri:
- Itara ritukura n’itara ry’icyatsi kibisi azima akurikirana yabanje kwakirizwa rimwe.

articles.title: Amatara yo hejuru y'ibisate by'umuhanda (Overhead lane control signals)
articles.content:
1. Ibimenyetso bimurika byerekana uburyo bwo kugendera mu muhanda kw’ibinyabiziga bishyirwa iburyo bw’umuhanda ukurikije icyerekezo abagenzi bireba baganamo. Ariko, bishobora no gushyirwa ibumoso cyangwa hejuru y’umuhanda n’ahandi hose bitunganiye uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda kugirango birusheho kugaragara bneza.
12. Ibimenyetso bimurika byo kugendera mu muhanda biri mu buryo bw’amatara abiri bishobora gushyirwa hejuru y’ibisate by’umuhanda, bikavuga ibi bikurikira:
a) Itara ritukura, (ryitiriwe umusaraba wa mutagatifu Andereya) risobanura ko kugenda kuri icyo gisate cy’umuhanda rigenga bibujijwe ku bayobozi bakigana;
b) Itara ry’icyatsi kibisi risa n’akarangacyerekezo gafite isonga ryerekeye hasi, risobanura ko kugenda ku gisate cy’umuhanda rigena byemewe ku bayobozi bakigana.
13. Ahantu uburyo bwo kugendera mu muhanda byerekanwa n’ibimenyetso bimurika, ibinyabiziga bishobora kuhagenda biteganye n’aho umubare wabyo utatuma biba ngombwa.

articles.title: Itara ry'umuhondo rimyatsa (Flashing amber warning light)
articles.content:
1. Kugirango berekane ahantu habi cyane, hakoreshwa ikimenyetso cy’itara ry’umuhondo rimyatsa rivuga uburenganzira bwo gutambuka icyo kimenyetso barushijeho kwitonda. Iryo tara rigomba kugaragara n’ijoro no ku manywa, ntacyo rihindura ku mategeko agenga uguhita mbere.
2. Iyo itara ry’umuhondo rimyatsa rikoreshejwe mu masangano y’amayira ahwanyeje agaciro, rishyirwa kuri buri nzira cyangwa hagati y’amasangano ku buryo ribonwa n’umuyobozi wese ugiye kuyinjiramo.
3. Iyo itara ry’umuhondo rimyatsa riri ku kintu kimwe n’ibimenyetso bimurika byerekana uburyo bwo kugenrera mu muhanda, cyangwa hafi yacyo, ntirishobora kwakira rimwe na byo.

articles.content:

2. Amatara cyangwa ibikoresho ngarura-rumuri bikoreshwa kugirango bigaragaze inkengero z’inzira nyabagendwa bigomba gushyirwaho ku buryo abagendera kuri iyo nkengero ihwanye n’uburyo bwo kugendera mu muhanda babona gusa iburyo bwabo iby’ibara ritukura cyangwa risa n’icunga rihishije naho ibumoso bwabo iby’ibara ryera.
